text: All documents concerning the receipt, application, reversal and non-application of the four payments of $1,899.56 received on or about May 2, May 10, May 17 and June 18, 2025, including cash-application records, system notes, return or NSF notices received from any depositary institution, and all documents reflecting the reason for each reversal entry.
serves_element: RESPA covered error - failure to apply a payment
why_this_party: Shellpoint was the servicer of record from 07/07/2024 and generated every one of these ledger entries.
expected_yield: Cash-application detail and any actual return notices.
impact_if_produced: If no return notice exists for any tender, three NSF reversals become indefensible and the retained 05/17/25 tender becomes a clean RESPA payment-application error.
impact_if_refused: A refusal, or a production with no return notices, is itself strong: the NSF entries each show $0.00 and nothing corroborates an actual return.
objection_response: Narrowly bounded to four identified transactions over an eight-week window against a defendant that generated them. Burden is minimal.
narrowed_from: An earlier draft sought 'all payment records'; narrowed to four identified tenders.
notes: THE HIGHEST-VALUE REQUEST IN THE PLAN. It targets the matter's strongest documented fact.

text: For each of the three entries designated 'NSF Fee Assessment' dated May 8, May 15 and June 25, 2025, state whether the corresponding payment was returned unpaid by any depositary institution, identify the institution and the return reason code, and state why each such entry was recorded in the amount of $0.00.
serves_element: RESPA covered error; FDCPA false representation
why_this_party: Only the servicer knows why its own system recorded an NSF event with no charge.
expected_yield: A sworn answer that either identifies a real return or concedes there was none.
impact_if_produced: A concession that no payment was returned converts the ledger into evidence of misapplication.
impact_if_refused: An evasive or qualified answer is usable on its own.
anticipated_objections: Compound; calls for a legal conclusion
objection_response: Not compound - three parallel factual sub-parts about three identified entries. No legal conclusion is sought.
notes: Paired deliberately with RFP-01: the document request may produce nothing if no return notice exists, and the sworn answer cannot.

text: All documents concerning the ownership of the Loan from July 21, 2022 to the present, including the instrument by which MEB Loan Trust VIII acquired any interest, all investor reporting for the Loan, and all records reflecting the entry of investor information into the MERS system for MIN 1015066-5000019200-2.
why_this_party: Shellpoint populates the registry investor field and told Plaintiffs in writing that MEB is the owner.
expected_yield: The acquisition instrument and the registry audit trail.
impact_if_produced: Resolves the FREED-versus-MEB inconsistency in the defendants' own records.
impact_if_refused: A refusal on a point the defendant itself put in writing is difficult to sustain and is usable.
anticipated_objections: Relevance - Defendants will argue ownership is irrelevant because Plaintiffs lack standing to challenge the assignment.
objection_response: The request does not challenge the assignment. It asks the defendants to reconcile two of their OWN inconsistent records - which goes to the reliability of the records underlying every figure in the case.
narrowed_from: An earlier draft sought the full securitization file; narrowed to this loan's ownership records.
notes: Framing matters here. Ask as a records-reliability question, not as a chain-of-title attack.

text: The meaning and application of each transaction code, reversal code, flag and money-type designation appearing on the account history for loan number 1030418553, including the circumstances in which a 'Principal Only Payment' entry may carry a negative amount, the circumstances in which an 'NSF Fee Assessment' may be recorded in the amount of $0.00, and the order in which funds are applied.
serves_element: RESPA covered error; the meaning of the ledger itself
why_this_party: Only the servicer can bind itself to what its own codes mean.
expected_yield: Testimony binding Shellpoint on the ledger's own vocabulary.
impact_if_produced: Resolves whether the negative 'Principal Only Payment' entries of 11/16/2022 and 02/09/2023 are draws, corrections, or something else - currently [UNRESOLVED] and currently the subject of a WRONG annotation in the client's own file.
impact_if_refused: An unprepared witness on a properly noticed topic is a sanctionable failure to prepare and is sometimes the more useful outcome.
objection_response: Bounded to one loan's account history and three identified code behaviours.
notes: A document request for 'the code key' may produce nothing if no such document exists. This topic does not have that gap.

text: All records for the depositary account from which payments to loan number 1030418553 were tendered between April 1 and July 31, 2025, including statements, ACH debit records, and any return or reversal notices.
why_this_party: This is Plaintiffs' OWN bank. No subpoena may even be necessary - the client can request the records directly.
expected_yield: Bank records showing whether each tender cleared.
impact_if_produced: If the tenders cleared and were never returned, the three NSF reversals are directly contradicted by a neutral third party.
notes: PHASE 0 - obtainable without discovery, from the client's own bank. Listed as a subpoena only as a fallback. This should happen this week regardless of the discovery gate.

text: Admit that the payment of $1,899.56 recorded as received on May 17, 2025 was not returned unpaid by any depositary institution.
why_this_party: Shellpoint recorded the entry and did not reverse it.
expected_yield: An admission, or a denial that is impeachable by the bank records.
impact_if_produced: An admission removes the innocent explanation from the strongest fact in the matter.
impact_if_refused: A denial sets up impeachment once SUBP-01 returns.
anticipated_objections: None substantial - single fact, plainly relevant.
notes: Deliberately addressed to the ONE tender that was never reversed. Single-fact so it cannot draw a qualified denial.

text: All Notices of Error, Requests for Information and Qualified Written Requests received concerning the Loan, all acknowledgments and substantive responses, and the policies and procedures identifying Shellpoint's designated address for error resolution in effect from July 7, 2024 to the present.
serves_element: RESPA - whether a qualifying notice was received at the designated address
why_this_party: Shellpoint is the recipient and the author of the acknowledgments alleged.
expected_yield: The inquiries as Shellpoint received them, and the designated-address policy.
impact_if_produced: Closes the gap that currently makes Counts I-III likely to be dismissed.
impact_if_refused: A refusal, after the pleading asserts thirteen acknowledgments, is untenable.
objection_response: Bounded to the designated-address policy only, and to the period of this defendant's servicing.
notes: Counts I-III currently fail on this element. This request and the client's own sent file are the two routes to closing it.

text: All documents concerning the entry dated September 26, 2023 reversing the $10,000.00 principal payment posted September 15, 2023, and all documents concerning the $855.00 received September 26, 2023 and removed from unapplied funds on October 11, 2023, including reason codes, system notes and any communication with Plaintiffs.
serves_element: RESPA covered error during SLS's tenure
why_this_party: Both entries are marked 'PriorServicer' on the ledger and occurred during SLS's servicing tenure.
expected_yield: The reason codes the ledger omits.
impact_if_produced: Explains two unexplained reversals, or establishes that no reason was recorded.
impact_if_refused: A refusal on the ground that SLS merged into NewRez does not answer where the records went.
anticipated_objections: Party status - Defendants contend SLS merged into NewRez in May 2024 and is not separately suable.
objection_response: Directed to SLS and, in the alternative, to NewRez as its successor. The merger is Defendants' own assertion; a successor holds the predecessor's records.
notes: Note that these are SLS-era events. The pleading currently misattributes the $855 to Shellpoint - see PD-07.

text: All documents concerning the employment offer extended to Christopher J. Carrelha, its rescission, and any consumer report or background screening obtained in connection with it, including any adverse action notice.
serves_element: FCRA actual damages; wrongful foreclosure special damages
why_this_party: Mercer Advisors and its screening vendor are the only sources for whether a consumer report was pulled and what it showed.
expected_yield: The offer, the rescission, and any adverse-action notice.
impact_if_produced: Converts the largest damages figure in the case from an allegation into a documented loss, and supplies the causal link the FCRA count needs.
impact_if_refused: If no consumer report was pulled, the causation theory collapses - which is worth knowing before it is pleaded again.
objection_response: Narrow, single-candidate scope; a protective order can be offered.
notes: The single largest damages figure in the matter rests entirely on an allegation. Third parties are slow - start early.
